note: Week 4 review follow-up: development cases for the relevance/abstention check. Results on this set MAY be used to choose the check. Separate from the frozen 18-case benchmark (eval/eval_cases.json, unchanged) and from the frozen relevance set (eval/relevance_frozen.json).

kinds.off_topic_overlap: shares policy vocabulary with the question but answers a different question; a real, correctly cited quote
kinds.on_topic: a correct, cited answer that must stay answered
kinds.reversal: cites a real quote but the answer reverses or changes its meaning (clause swap, antonym, before/after)

replies: Hand-written replies, modelled on the real off-topic replies recorded in eval_results.json (no-floor diagnostic: U1, U2, U9b). They are not model output, so they test the server checks deterministically; they do not measure how often the model produces such replies.
author: assistant (Claude), 2026-11-16

cases.question: How much notice do reminders give before a visit?
cases.answer: Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice are recorded as late cancellations.
quotes: Cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice are recorded as late cancellations.

cases.question: Can I switch my reminders to email?
cases.answer: Turning reminders off does not change the cancellation policy.
quotes: Turning reminders off does not change the cancellation policy.

cases.question: Is there a limit on how often I reschedule?
cases.answer: An appointment can be moved to a new date or time up to 2 hours before it starts, at no cost.
quotes: An appointment can be moved to a new date or time up to 2 hours before it starts, at no cost.

cases.question: How much is the late cancellation fee?
cases.answer: Appointments can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start time.
quotes: Appointments can be cancelled free of charge up to 24 hours before the start time.

cases.question: How many days does the clinic take to answer a data request?
cases.answer: Refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 10 working days.
quotes: Refunds are reviewed by the billing team and, if approved, paid back to the original payment method within 10 working days.

cases.question: What happens if I miss my telehealth video call?
cases.answer: Telehealth visits take place by video in the patient app.
quotes: Telehealth visits take place by video in the patient app.

cases.question: When is the second reminder sent?
cases.answer: Reminders are sent by text message by default.
quotes: Reminders are sent by text message by default

cases.question: How do I request a refund?
cases.answer: Late cancellation fees are refunded only if the cancellation was caused by a clinic error.
quotes: Late cancellation fees are refunded only if the cancellation was caused by a clinic error.

cases.question: Who can see my personal data?
cases.answer: Reminders never contain test results or details of the reason for the visit.
quotes: Reminders never contain test results or details of the reason for the visit.

cases.question: Can I change a telehealth visit to an in-person one?
cases.answer: Telehealth visits follow the same cancellation policy as in-person visits.
quotes: Telehealth visits follow the same cancellation policy as in-person visits.

cases.question: How early should I join a telehealth visit?
cases.answer: If the connection fails, the clinician calls the patient's phone number on file and continues by phone.
quotes: If the connection fails, the clinician calls the patient's phone number on file and continues by phone.

cases.question: Is there a charge for moving my visit to another day?
cases.answer: Yes, it can be moved to a new date or time up to 2 hours before it starts, at no cost.
quotes: An appointment can be moved to a new date or time up to 2 hours before it starts, at no cost.

cases.question: How long before my visit do reminders arrive?
cases.answer: The clinic sends a reminder 48 hours before each appointment and a second reminder 2 hours before it.
quotes: The clinic sends a reminder 48 hours before each appointment and a second reminder 2 hours before it.

cases.question: What is the fee if I cancel late for the third time?
cases.answer: A late cancellation fee of 15 euros applies to the third late cancellation within 12 months.
quotes: A late cancellation fee of 15 euros applies to the third late cancellation within 12 months, and to every late cancellation after that.

cases.question: Can someone else get my personal data?
cases.answer: Only someone the patient has authorised in writing; the clinic only shares a patient's personal data with that patient or with them.
quotes: The clinic only shares a patient's personal data with that patient, or with someone they have authorised in writing.

cases.question: What if my video connection drops?
cases.answer: If the connection fails, the clinician calls the patient's phone number on file and continues by phone.
quotes: If the connection fails, the clinician calls the patient's phone number on file and continues by phone.

cases.question: How many days until an approved refund is paid?
cases.answer: Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 10 working days.
quotes: Refunds are reviewed by the billing team and, if approved, paid back to the original payment method within 10 working days.

cases.question: How often am I allowed to reschedule a visit?
cases.answer: Each appointment can be rescheduled at most twice.
quotes: Each appointment can be rescheduled at most twice

cases.question: Does a missed appointment count as a late cancellation?
cases.answer: Yes, missed appointments without any cancellation are recorded as no-shows and are treated the same way as late cancellations.
quotes: Missed appointments without any cancellation are recorded as no-shows and are treated the same way as late cancellations.

cases.question: How long before the visit can I reschedule?
cases.answer: An appointment can be moved up to 2 hours after it starts.
quotes: An appointment can be moved to a new date or time up to 2 hours before it starts, at no cost.

cases.question: When are reminders sent?
cases.answer: The clinic sends a reminder 2 hours before each appointment and a second reminder 48 hours before it.
quotes: The clinic sends a reminder 48 hours before each appointment and a second reminder 2 hours before it.

cases.question: When does the late cancellation fee apply?
cases.answer: A late cancellation fee of 15 euros applies to the first late cancellation within 12 months.
quotes: A late cancellation fee of 15 euros applies to the third late cancellation within 12 months, and to every late cancellation after that.

cases.question: Can I switch reminders to email?
cases.answer: No, patients cannot switch reminders to email in the patient app.
quotes: patients can switch to email or turn reminders off in the patient app.

cases.question: Do telehealth visits follow the cancellation policy?
cases.answer: Telehealth visits do not follow the same cancellation policy as in-person visits.
quotes: Telehealth visits follow the same cancellation policy as in-person visits.

cases.question: Who reviews refund requests?
cases.answer: Refunds are rejected by the billing team.
quotes: Refunds are reviewed by the billing team and, if approved, paid back to the original payment method within 10 working days.
